research.notes: Could not identify the organization. No registry record (IRS, CA SOS, SAM.gov) or official website tied to an Oakland 'Global Seed' was found. Candidates that do NOT match: global-seed.com (Hong Kong sourcing company), globalseed.info (Serbian organic farm), globalseed.org (Sustainable Environment Education Demonstrations), Global Seed LLC (inactive CA LLC, 2015), Global Seed Planters (nonprofit, unrelated). A Berkeley Parents Network listing describes a 'Global Seed' high school exchange program for students from tsunami-affected Japan, which is a possible but unconfirmed link to the OUSD Linked Learning / CTE contracts; no website, registry entry or Oakland-specific page was found to confirm it.
